user.title: HA Eco
user.description:
Computes the consumption, electricity mix, and costs of your household and of each device. If you like, also what your solar panels, heat pump, and electric car have saved, and when they pay for themselves.

From your energy dashboard:
{grid} Grid import with electricity price
{export} Feed-in
{compensation} Feed-in compensation
✓ Solar production: {solar} sources
{battery} Battery
✓ Individual devices: {devices}

pv.title: Solar

wallbox.title: Electric car
wallbox.description: Compares the electric car with a combustion car, if you like. What is charged at the wallbox is measured.

data_description.comparison: Nothing, as for a second car: no saving, but charging costs and mix
data_description.investment: Extra purchase cost over a combustion car. For the payback.

wallbox_values.title: Average since {since}
wallbox_values.description: For the time since {since}, Home Assistant knows neither fuel prices nor consumptions. Enter averages. They also apply from now on, until you change them. Savings are counted only from this date; earlier savings are not included. This is the start of meter data, not the installation or purchase date.

data_description.ev_consumption: At the wallbox with charging losses, usually 10–15 % above the car's display. With several cars, their average.
data_description.combustion_consumption: What a comparable combustion car would have used
data_description.tariff: Only with a separate tariff for the car; otherwise the energy dashboard's price counts
data_description.fuel_price_entity: Replaces the average from now on
data_description.ev_consumption_entity: Provides the current consumption in kWh/100 km from the changeover time
data_description.combustion_consumption_entity: Provides the current comparison consumption in l/100 km from the changeover time

wallbox_values_none.title: Average since {since}
wallbox_values_none.description: Without a comparison there is no saving. HA Eco shows the charging costs, their mix, and the average price. A tariff of your own applies since {since} and from now on, until you change it.

data_description.tariff: Only with a separate tariff for the car; otherwise the energy dashboard's price counts

error.heat_device_none: This device has no energy meter. Choose the heat meters below.
error.heat_device_ambiguous: This device has several energy meters. Choose the heat meters below, in the order of the electricity meters.
error.investment_without_comparison: Without a comparison there is no saving to pay back an extra cost. Leave it empty.
error.historical_values_required: Enter all required historical energy totals, average prices, and a start date.
error.historical_future_date: The start date cannot be in the future.

abort.no_energy_dashboard: First set up the grid import with an electricity price in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy). Then you can add HA Eco.
abort.energy_interface: The energy dashboard cannot be read. This version of Home Assistant is not supported yet; please look for an update of HA Eco.
abort.single_instance_allowed: HA Eco is already set up. Add more on its integration page.

create_entry.default: The past is now being computed; with several years of data this can take a few minutes. Add the dashboard "HA Eco" under [Settings › Dashboards](/config/lovelace/dashboards) › "Add dashboard". Its cards are also under "Add card".

data_description.battery_investment: The battery's own payback starts with its first recorded charge or discharge; earlier savings are not included. Enter the battery cost here only; the PV purchase cost above must exclude it. The PV payback includes both.

recompute.title: Recompute
recompute.description: Computes the solar saving again with the current data, for example after you corrected a wrong reading in the statistics. Your values stay as they are.

historical.title: Historical energy data
historical.description: Enter totals from the start date through the moment you save (today). These values replace all Home Assistant recorder data in that interval; HA Eco resumes meter-based calculations at the next full hour. No partial periods or artificial hourly/monthly history are calculated.

data_description.historical_enabled: Can be disabled at any time; entered values are preserved.
data_description.since: Start of the period covered by the totals below through the time you save. It may be before or after Home Assistant recording began.
data_description.solar_kwh: Total PV production in kWh from the start date through saving.
data_description.export_kwh: Total energy exported to the grid in kWh over the same period.
data_description.electricity_price: Average price per kWh for the entire period from the start date through saving. For dynamic tariffs, use a consumption-weighted average where possible.
data_description.feed_in_price: Average compensation per exported kWh over the same period.
data_description.battery_charge_kwh: Total energy charged into the battery over the same period.
data_description.battery_discharge_kwh: Total energy discharged from the battery over the same period.

error.heat_device_none: This device has no energy meter. Choose the heat meters below.

recompute.title: Recompute
recompute.description: Computes the electric car again with the current data, for example after you corrected a wrong reading in the statistics. Your values stay as they are.

historical.title: Historical energy data
historical.description: Enter totals from the start date through the moment you save (today). These values replace all Home Assistant recorder data in that interval; HA Eco resumes meter-based calculations at the next full hour. No partial periods or artificial hourly/monthly history are calculated.

data_description.historical_enabled: Can be disabled at any time; entered values are preserved.
data_description.since: Start of the period covered by the totals below through the time you save. It may be before or after Home Assistant recording began.
data_description.electricity_kwh: Total energy charged at the wallbox from the start date through saving.
data_description.ev_consumption: Average kWh per 100 km at the wallbox, including charging losses.
data_description.combustion_consumption: Average fuel consumption of a comparable combustion car in litres per 100 km.
data_description.electricity_price: Average price per kWh for the entire period from the start date through saving. For dynamic tariffs, use a consumption-weighted average where possible.
data_description.fuel_price: Consumption-weighted average price of the former heating fuel or petrol over the same period.

energy_interface.title: HA Eco cannot read the energy dashboard
energy_interface.description: This version of Home Assistant stores the energy dashboard or its statistics in a way HA Eco does not understand. The savings are unavailable until HA Eco is updated.

no_grid_price.title: HA Eco is missing the electricity price
no_grid_price.description: The energy dashboard has no grid import with an electricity price anymore. The savings keep their last values until it is set up again in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy).

missing_meter.title: {category}: meter missing in the energy dashboard
missing_meter.description: The energy dashboard no longer has: {meters}. {category} keeps its last figures until this is fixed. Add the meter back in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy), or choose other meters with Reconfigure on the integration page of HA Eco.

missing_price_entity.title: {category}: price sensor missing
missing_price_entity.description: The price sensor {entity} no longer exists. Until it is replaced, its last value counts. Choose another one, or none, under Reconfigure › Values from now on on the integration page of HA Eco.

invalid_price_entity.title: {category}: price sensor has an incompatible unit
invalid_price_entity.description: The unit {unit} of {entity} cannot be read as {expected}. Use that unit, cents per fuel unit, or a unitless numeric helper. Until corrected, the last valid price or the entered average counts.
